It requires keeping up-to-date with the latest advancements in technology, troubleshooting issues, and optimizing system performance.

NAME: Software Development
DESCRIPTION: Software development is the process of designing, creating, testing, and maintaining computer programs or software applications. It involves a specialized skill set, including knowledge of programming languages, algorithms, databases, and user interface design. Software developers use their skills to solve complex problems and create efficient, user-friendly software solutions that meet specific business or user needs. The tasks of software development include coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and collaboration with other members of the project team.

NAME: Technical Support
DESCRIPTION: Technical Support refers to the assistance provided to users of technology products or services, aimed at resolving issues and ensuring optimal functionality. This skill involves diagnosing technical problems, guiding users through troubleshooting steps, and providing solutions to enhance user experience. Knowledge of Technical Support is utilized to address software, hardware, and network-related inquiries, facilitating effective use of technology in various environments.

NAME: IBM i
DESCRIPTION: IBM i refers to an integrated operating system designed for IBM Power Systems, known for its reliability, security, and scalability. This skill encompasses knowledge of system administration, application development, and database management within the IBM i environment. Proficiency in IBM i is used to manage enterprise applications, streamline business processes, and ensure data integrity through robust system operations and maintenance. Understanding IBM i enables users to leverage its capabilities for efficient resource management and application deployment in various organizational contexts.

NAME: Chemistry
DESCRIPTION: Chemistry refers to the scientific study of matter, its properties, composition, and the changes it undergoes during chemical reactions. This skill encompasses understanding the interactions between different substances, which enables the user to analyze and predict chemical behavior in various contexts. Knowledge of Chemistry is applied in fields such as pharmaceuticals, environmental science, and materials development, facilitating the creation of new compounds, the assessment of environmental impacts, and the innovation of materials with specific properties.

NAME: Electrical Engineering
DESCRIPTION: Electrical Engineering refers to the branch of engineering that deals with the study, design, and application of electrical systems and devices. This skill encompasses knowledge of circuit design, power generation, and control systems, enabling the analysis and development of electrical equipment and infrastructure. Understanding Electrical Engineering is used to create solutions for various applications, including energy distribution, telecommunications, and electronic devices, by ensuring efficient and reliable operation of electrical systems.

NAME: Applied Mathematics
DESCRIPTION: Applied Mathematics is the use of mathematical principles and methods to solve practical problems in fields such as engineering, physics, biology, economics, and finance. It requires knowledge of mathematical concepts and their applications in the real world, as well as the ability to analyze data, build models, and make predictions. Applied mathematicians work in a variety of settings, including academia, government, and industry, and use their skills to develop solutions to complex problems and improve decision-making processes.

NAME: Systems Engineering
DESCRIPTION: Systems Engineering is a process-oriented interdisciplinary field of study that focuses on designing, developing, analyzing, and managing complex systems. This specialized skill involves the application of engineering principles, methods, and techniques to optimize a system's performance, functionality, and cost-effectiveness while meeting the requirements and goals of stakeholders. Systems Engineers work in various domains and industries, such as aerospace, defense, automotive, healthcare, energy, and telecommunications, to name a few, and help organizations deploy robust, reliable, and user-friendly systems that improve efficiency and productivity.

NAME: Appraisals
DESCRIPTION: Appraisals are a specialized skill that requires expertise and knowledge to accurately evaluate the value of tangible and intangible assets. The process involves determining the current market value of a particular item or asset and requires a thorough understanding of the industry, specific item or asset, and market trends. An appraisal conducted by a qualified professional can help individuals and organizations make informed decisions regarding investments, sales, insurance coverage, taxes, and more.

NAME: App Store (IOS)
DESCRIPTION: App Store (IOS) is skills related to the marketplace for IOS applications where users download and install applications to their IOS devices. This involves knowledge of app development, app store optimization (ASO), app monetization, and app marketing. The skill requires proficiency in the use of the App Store Connect platform and understanding of Apple's App Review Guidelines. Overall, it involves strategies and techniques to deliver a successful application to the IOS marketplace.

NAME: Arbitration
DESCRIPTION: Arbitration is the process of resolving legal disputes outside of court. It involves an impartial third party known as an arbitrator who reviews the evidence presented by both sides and makes a binding decision. NAME: Bakery Experience

NAME: Balance Sheet

It requires specialized skills as it involves careful analysis of the different components of a company's financial statements, including cash flow statements and income statements. A balance sheet provides valuable insights into a company's financial health and is essential for making effective financial decisions. The skills required to create and analyze a balance sheet include accounting and finance knowledge, attention to detail, analytical ability, and critical thinking skills.

NAME: Reconciliation
DESCRIPTION: Reconciliation refers to the process of ensuring that two sets of records or accounts are in agreement and accurately reflect the same financial information. This skill involves comparing data from different sources, identifying discrepancies, and making necessary adjustments to achieve consistency. NAME: Human Nutrition

It also requires a deep understanding of accounting principles, bank operations, and financial management. A skilled accountant or bookkeeper can ensure that bank reconciliation is performed accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner.

DESCRIPTION: Lathes are machines used to create cylindrical or conical shapes by rotating a piece of material while a cutting tool shapes it. This process requires specialized skills because it involves precise measurements, tool selection, and cutting techniques. Lathes are commonly used in manufacturing industries such as aerospace, automotive, and medical device manufacturing. Skilled lathe operators are in demand and can earn a good living.

NAME: Benchmarking
DESCRIPTION: Benchmarking is a skill that involves the knowledge and application of key industry standards that provide value to customers. It requires the understanding of how to apply benchmark workloads, which are sets of tasks or operations used to compare the performance of different systems or devices. This skill is used to evaluate and improve performance, ensuring that products, services, or processes meet or exceed industry standards.

NAME: Cost Benefit Analysis
DESCRIPTION: Cost Benefit Analysis refers to a systematic approach for evaluating the strengths and weaknesses of alternatives in order to determine the best option based on their costs and benefits. This skill involves quantifying the expected costs and benefits associated with a project or decision, enabling informed decision-making. Knowledge of Cost Benefit Analysis is used to assess the feasibility and potential impact of various initiatives, guiding resource allocation and strategic planning.

NAME: Benefits Administration
DESCRIPTION: Benefits Administration refers to the process of managing employee benefits programs, including health insurance, retirement plans, and other perks offered by an organization. This skill encompasses the evaluation, implementation, and communication of benefits options to ensure compliance with regulations and alignment with organizational goals. Knowledge of Benefits Administration is used to facilitate enrollment, address employee inquiries, and analyze the effectiveness of benefits offerings, ultimately supporting employee satisfaction and retention.

NAME: Social Security
DESCRIPTION: Social Security refers to a government program that provides financial assistance to individuals in various circumstances, including retirement, disability, and survivorship. This skill encompasses knowledge of the eligibility criteria, benefits calculation, and application processes associated with Social Security programs. Understanding Social Security is used to navigate the complexities of the system, ensuring individuals receive the appropriate benefits and support based on their specific situations.

NAME: Border Gateway Protocol
DESCRIPTION: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) is a protocol used for exchanging routing information between different Autonomous Systems (ASes) on the internet. It is used to establish and maintain routing tables among routers in order to ensure efficient and effective routing of data packets. BGP is a complex protocol and requires specialized skills in order to configure, troubleshoot, and optimize routing between different networks.

NAME: Business Intelligence
DESCRIPTION: Business Intelligence is the process of gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data in order to make informed business decisions. It involves using specialized software and tools to extract valuable insights from large datasets and visualizing those insights in a meaningful way. Business Intelligence professionals must possess strong analytical and technical skills, as well as the ability to communicate complex data to non-technical stakeholders.

NAME: Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP/BiPAP)
DESCRIPTION: Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP/BiPAP) refers to a method of providing respiratory support through the delivery of pressurized air to maintain open airways in individuals with breathing difficulties. This skill involves the use of devices that deliver continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) or bilevel positive airway pressure (BiPAP) to assist with ventilation and improve oxygenation. Knowledge of Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP/BiPAP) is applied in clinical settings to manage conditions such as obstructive sleep apnea and respiratory failure by ensuring adequate airflow and reducing the work of breathing.

NAME: Bicycles
DESCRIPTION: Bicycles refer to two-wheeled vehicles powered by human pedaling, designed for various purposes including transportation, recreation, and sport. Bicycles are utilized in commuting, exercise, and leisure activities, providing a sustainable and efficient mode of travel. They consist of essential components such as frames, wheels, pedals, and handlebars, which contribute to their functionality and performance. The use of bicycles promotes physical fitness and can reduce environmental impact by lowering reliance on motor vehicles.

NAME: Bidding
DESCRIPTION: Bidding is the process of submitting a proposal or offer to compete for a contract or project. It requires specialized skills such as assessing the needs of the client, creating a competitive bid strategy, determining costs and profitability, and presenting the proposal in a clear and convincing manner. The bidding process involves a mix of technical, financial, and business skills, as well as effective communication and negotiation skills. Winning bids can be highly profitable for businesses, but the competition for contracts can be intense.

NAME: Big Data
DESCRIPTION: Big Data refers to the vast volumes of structured and unstructured data generated from various sources, which are too large or complex for traditional data processing applications. This skill encompasses the techniques and tools used to collect, store, analyze, and visualize data to uncover patterns, trends, and insights. Knowledge of Big Data is utilized in diverse fields such as healthcare, finance, and marketing to inform decision-making, enhance operational efficiency, and drive innovation through data-driven strategies.

NAME: Billing
DESCRIPTION: Billing is the process of generating invoices or bills for goods or services provided by a business to its clients or customers. It involves gathering all the necessary information related to the transaction, calculating costs, and creating accurate invoices. Effective billing requires specialized knowledge of accounting principles, billing software, and legal and regulatory compliance. It is an important aspect of business operations as it ensures timely payment and helps maintain financial stability.

NAME: Billing Systems
DESCRIPTION: Billing Systems refer to the software and processes used to manage and automate the billing and invoicing functions of an organization. This skill encompasses the ability to generate invoices, track payments, and manage customer accounts, ensuring accurate financial records and timely revenue collection. Knowledge of Billing Systems is utilized to streamline financial operations, reduce errors, and enhance customer satisfaction through efficient billing practices.

NAME: Building Information Modeling
DESCRIPTION: Building Information Modeling refers to the digital representation of the physical and functional characteristics of a building. This skill involves the creation and management of information throughout the project lifecycle, enabling collaboration among stakeholders in design, construction, and operation. Knowledge of Building Information Modeling is used to enhance project visualization, improve coordination, and facilitate decision-making by providing accurate data and insights into building performance and costs.

NAME: Biochemistry
DESCRIPTION: Biochemistry refers to the study of chemical processes and substances that occur within living organisms. This skill encompasses the understanding of molecular structures, metabolic pathways, and the interactions between biomolecules, which are essential for life. Knowledge of Biochemistry is used to analyze biological functions, develop pharmaceuticals, and enhance agricultural practices by manipulating biochemical pathways to improve health and productivity.

NAME: Biotechnology
DESCRIPTION: Biotechnology refers to the use of biological systems, organisms, or derivatives to develop or create products and technologies that improve human life and the environment. This skill encompasses techniques such as genetic engineering, cell culture, and molecular biology, which enable advancements in fields like medicine, agriculture, and environmental science. Knowledge of Biotechnology is applied to produce pharmaceuticals, enhance crop resilience, and develop sustainable biofuels, among other applications, by manipulating biological processes and materials.

NAME: Molecular Biology
DESCRIPTION: Molecular Biology refers to the branch of science that studies the structure and function of biological molecules, particularly nucleic acids and proteins. This skill encompasses techniques for analyzing genetic material, understanding cellular processes, and exploring molecular interactions. Knowledge of Molecular Biology is used to advance research in genetics, biotechnology, and medicine by enabling the manipulation of DNA and RNA for applications such as gene therapy, diagnostics, and the development of new treatments.

NAME: Biodiversity
DESCRIPTION: Biodiversity refers to the variety of life forms within a given ecosystem, encompassing the diversity of species, genetic variations, and ecological processes. This skill involves understanding the interrelationships among organisms and their environments, which is essential for assessing ecosystem health and resilience. Knowledge of Biodiversity is used to inform conservation efforts, manage natural resources, and develop strategies for sustainable practices that support ecological balance.

NAME: Biology
DESCRIPTION: Biology refers to the scientific study of living organisms, encompassing their structure, function, growth, evolution, and interactions with their environment. This skill involves understanding various biological concepts, including genetics, ecology, and physiology, which enable the analysis of life processes and the relationships among different life forms. Knowledge of Biology is used to inform research in fields such as medicine, environmental science, and biotechnology, facilitating advancements in health care, conservation efforts, and the development of new technologies.

NAME: Health Informatics
DESCRIPTION: Health Informatics refers to the integration of healthcare, information technology, and data management to improve patient care and health outcomes. This skill encompasses the collection, analysis, and application of health data to support clinical decision-making, enhance operational efficiency, and facilitate research. Knowledge of Health Informatics is used to develop and implement electronic health records, health information exchanges, and data analytics tools that enable healthcare providers to deliver more effective and personalized care.

NAME: Medical Research
DESCRIPTION: Medical Research refers to the systematic investigation of health-related issues to enhance knowledge and improve patient care. This skill involves designing studies, collecting and analyzing data, and interpreting results to advance medical science and inform clinical practices. Knowledge of Medical Research is used to develop new treatments, understand disease mechanisms, and evaluate the effectiveness of interventions, ultimately contributing to evidence-based medicine.

NAME: Biosafety
DESCRIPTION: Biosafety refers to the principles and practices designed to protect human health and the environment from potential risks associated with biological materials. This skill encompasses the assessment, management, and containment of pathogens, genetically modified organisms, and other biohazards to prevent exposure and transmission. Knowledge of Biosafety is used to develop protocols and guidelines for laboratory practices, waste disposal, and emergency response, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and promoting safe handling of biological agents.

NAME: Childbirth
DESCRIPTION: Childbirth refers to the process of delivering a baby from the womb to the outside world, marking the culmination of pregnancy. This skill encompasses the physiological and medical aspects involved in labor, delivery, and postpartum care. Knowledge of Childbirth is used to manage the stages of labor, provide support to the birthing individual, and ensure the health and safety of both the mother and the newborn during the delivery process. Understanding this skill is essential for healthcare professionals involved in maternal and neonatal care.

NAME: BitLocker Drive Encryption
DESCRIPTION: BitLocker Drive Encryption is a security feature in Microsoft Windows that encrypts entire volumes of data stored on a computer's hard drive. It uses Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) encryption to protect data from unauthorized access or theft, making it an essential tool for securing sensitive information. The Specialized Skill involves knowledge of how to set up and manage BitLocker Drive Encryption, as well as troubleshooting common issues that may arise.

NAME: Business Development
DESCRIPTION: Business Development is a focused approach of identifying and pursuing new opportunities to grow a business. It involves various activities such as networking, building relationships, market analysis, and strategic planning. Business Development professionals have specialized skills in identifying and leveraging opportunities for revenue growth, strategic partnerships, and overall business expansion. They require strong communication and interpersonal skills, as well as analytical and strategic thinking ability.

NAME: Online Advertising
DESCRIPTION: Online Advertising refers to the practice of promoting products or services through digital channels to reach a targeted audience. This skill involves the use of various platforms, such as social media, search engines, and websites, to create and manage advertisements that drive traffic and engagement. Knowledge of Online Advertising is utilized to analyze consumer behavior, optimize ad performance, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns in achieving marketing objectives.

NAME: Blueprinting
DESCRIPTION: Blueprinting refers to the process of creating detailed plans or diagrams that outline the specifications and requirements for a project or system. This skill involves the use of design principles and technical knowledge to produce accurate representations that guide the development and implementation of various initiatives. Knowledge of Blueprinting is utilized to ensure clarity in communication among stakeholders, facilitate project execution, and maintain alignment with project objectives and standards.

NAME: BMC Remedy Action Request System
DESCRIPTION: BMC Remedy Action Request System is a software platform designed to streamline and automate various business processes. It allows organizations to create, manage and track requests, incidents, and changes, as well as integrates with other systems to provide a unified interface. Skilled professionals in BMC Remedy Action Request System are proficient in configuring and customizing the software, creating workflows, and implementing best practices to improve efficiency and productivity.

NAME: Body Language
DESCRIPTION: Body language is a type of communication in which physical behaviors, as opposed to words, are used to express or convey information. Such behavior includes facial expressions, body posture, gestures, eye movement, touch and the use of space. The term body language is usually applied in regard to people but may also be applied to animals. The study of body language is also known as kinesics.

NAME: Boilers
DESCRIPTION: Boilers refer to closed vessels that heat water or other fluids to generate steam or hot water for various applications. This skill encompasses knowledge of boiler design, operation, maintenance, and safety protocols, which are essential for ensuring efficient and safe performance. Understanding Boilers is used to support heating systems in residential, commercial, and industrial settings, as well as in power generation and process industries, by managing energy consumption and optimizing thermal efficiency.

NAME: Bootstrap (Front-End Framework)
DESCRIPTION: Bootstrap (Front-End Framework) is an open-source framework designed for developing responsive and mobile-first websites. This skill involves utilizing a collection of CSS and JavaScript components that streamline the design process, enabling the creation of visually appealing and functional web interfaces. Knowledge of Bootstrap (Front-End Framework) is applied to enhance user experience by ensuring consistent layout and design across various devices and screen sizes. It facilitates rapid development through pre-designed templates and components, allowing for efficient coding and implementation of web projects.

NAME: Spanning Tree Protocols
DESCRIPTION: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) is a network protocol that ensures a loop-free topology for any bridged Ethernet local area network (LAN). It is used to prevent network loops caused by multiple physical paths between devices. STP automatically disables some of these paths to ensure a single active path between any two network devices. Knowledge of STP is important for network engineers and administrators to ensure reliable and efficient network performance.

NAME: Passive Optical Networks
DESCRIPTION: Passive Optical Networks, or PON, is a telecommunication technology that uses fiber optic cables to transport data between a central office and multiple end-users, such as homes or businesses. It is a cost-effective solution for providing high-speed internet and other services with lower energy consumption than traditional copper cable networks. PON requires specialized skills and knowledge of fiber optic installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting to ensure smooth and efficient operations.

NAME: ASME Boiler And Pressure Vessel Code (BPVC)
DESCRIPTION: The ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (BPVC) is a set of standards and guidelines for designing, manufacturing, and inspecting boilers and pressure vessels. Compliance with the BPVC is necessary to ensure that these devices are safe and reliable. It requires specialized skills and knowledge in mechanical engineering, materials science, and inspection techniques. Individuals with these skills can work in industries such as oil and gas, power generation, and manufacturing, ensuring the safety and reliability of critical equipment.

NAME: Brainstorming
DESCRIPTION: Brainstorming is the process of generating creative and diverse ideas through group discussion and free-flowing thinking. It is a common skill used in problem-solving, decision-making, and innovation in various industries and professions. The aim of brainstorming is to come up with as many ideas as possible, without judgment or criticism, in order to explore all possible options and solutions. Effective brainstorming requires active participation, openness to new ideas, and the ability to build on the ideas of others.

NAME: Brand Awareness
DESCRIPTION: Brand Awareness refers to the extent to which consumers recognize and recall a brand and its products or services. This skill encompasses understanding consumer perceptions, market positioning, and the effectiveness of marketing strategies in creating familiarity with a brand. Knowledge of Brand Awareness is used to develop targeted marketing campaigns, enhance customer engagement, and measure the impact of branding efforts on consumer behavior.

NAME: Brand Management
DESCRIPTION: Brand Management is the ability to develop, implement, and maintain strategies and measures aimed at safeguarding a brand's identity, reputation, and assets from various threats, risks, and vulnerabilities. This skill involves creating and executing plans to protect and enhance the brand, ensuring consistency and positive associations in the eyes of stakeholders. Individuals with proficiency in Brand Management contribute to the long-term success and sustainability of the brand by mitigating risks and fostering a positive brand image.

NAME: Brand Identity
DESCRIPTION: Brand Identity refers to the visual and conceptual elements that represent a brand, including its name, logo, design, and overall messaging. This skill encompasses the development and management of these elements to create a cohesive and recognizable presence in the market. Knowledge of Brand Identity is used to differentiate a brand from competitors, establish emotional connections with consumers, and communicate the brand's values and mission effectively.

NAME: Breads
DESCRIPTION: Breads refers to a category of baked goods made from a mixture of flour, water, and other ingredients, which undergoes fermentation and baking processes. This skill encompasses techniques for preparing various types of bread, including kneading, proofing, and baking, to achieve desired textures and flavors. Knowledge of Breads is used to create a wide range of products, from artisanal loaves to flatbreads, by understanding ingredient interactions and baking methods. Mastery of this skill enables the production of bread that meets specific culinary standards and preferences.

NAME: Breakage Control
DESCRIPTION: Breakage Control refers to the systematic approach to managing and minimizing the occurrence of breakage in materials or products during handling, storage, and transportation. This skill involves the application of techniques and strategies to assess risk factors, implement protective measures, and monitor conditions that may lead to breakage. Knowledge of Breakage Control is utilized to enhance product integrity, reduce losses, and improve overall operational efficiency by ensuring that items remain intact throughout their lifecycle.

NAME: Network Bridges
DESCRIPTION: Network Bridges refer to devices that connect and filter traffic between two or more network segments, allowing them to function as a single network. This skill involves understanding the principles of data link layer operations, enabling the user to manage and optimize network performance by reducing collisions and improving communication efficiency. Knowledge of Network Bridges is applied in scenarios such as segmenting local area networks, enhancing bandwidth utilization, and maintaining network integrity through effective traffic management.

NAME: Voice Over IP
DESCRIPTION: Voice over IP (VoIP) is a technology that allows voice communications over the internet. It requires specialized skills to set up and optimize the network to ensure high-quality calls, secure connections, and uninterrupted service. VoIP specialists must have a solid understanding of network protocols and architectures, as well as experience in configuring and troubleshooting VoIP applications and hardware. They also need to keep up with the latest trends and innovations in the field to provide the best possible service to their clients.

NAME: Broadcasting
DESCRIPTION: Broadcasting refers to the distribution of audio and video content to a wide audience through various media channels, including television, radio, and online platforms. This skill encompasses the understanding of content creation, transmission technologies, and audience engagement strategies that facilitate effective communication. Knowledge of Broadcasting is used to produce and disseminate information, entertainment, and news, ensuring accessibility to diverse audiences while adhering to regulatory standards and ethical considerations.

NAME: Brochures
DESCRIPTION: Brochures refer to printed materials that provide information about products, services, or events in a visually appealing format. This skill involves the design, layout, and content creation necessary to effectively communicate key messages to a target audience. Knowledge of Brochures is used to enhance marketing efforts, educate consumers, and promote brand awareness through strategic use of imagery and text.

NAME: Brokerage
DESCRIPTION: Brokerage is the activity of acting as an intermediary between buyers and sellers of various assets, such as stocks, real estate, or commodities. It requires specialized skills in negotiation, communication, market analysis, and knowledge of legal regulations. Successful brokerage requires the ability to balance the interests of both parties to facilitate a transaction that satisfies both sides.

NAME: ISO 9000 Series
DESCRIPTION: The ISO 9000 Series is a set of international standards that outline requirements for quality management systems. It provides guidelines for organizations to consistently meet customer and regulatory requirements, improve processes, and achieve customer satisfaction. Understanding and implementing these standards requires specialized knowledge and skills in quality management and auditing.

NAME: Financial Forecasting
DESCRIPTION: Financial Forecasting is a skill that involves the use of historical data and other relevant information to make informed predictions about future trends. This skill is crucial in determining the direction of various financial aspects such as revenue, sales, and costs. It enables the user to anticipate potential financial outcomes and make strategic decisions accordingly.

NAME: Cost Management
DESCRIPTION: Cost Management is the ability to select and oversee external legal counsel while efficiently managing both internal and external legal costs, ensuring the delivery of cost-effective legal services. Professionals with this skill employ strategic approaches to budgeting, resource allocation, and negotiation to optimize legal expenses. They play a crucial role in balancing the need for high-quality legal support with the imperative to control and streamline costs, contributing to the overall financial health and sustainability of the organization.

NAME: Budget Support
DESCRIPTION: Budget Support refers to the assistance provided in the planning, monitoring, and management of financial resources within an organization or project. This skill encompasses the analysis of budgetary needs, the development of financial plans, and the evaluation of expenditures to ensure alignment with strategic objectives. Knowledge of Budget Support is used to facilitate informed decision-making, enhance financial accountability, and optimize resource allocation by providing insights into financial performance and potential areas for cost savings.

NAME: Customer Relationship Management
DESCRIPTION: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) is the practice of managing relationships with customers and potential customers. It involves the use of technology, processes, and strategies to analyze customer interactions and data, and to enhance customer satisfaction, retention, and loyalty. CRM professionals specialize in implementing CRM systems, developing customer communication strategies, and analyzing customer behavior and feedback to improve business operations and drive revenue growth. Effective CRM requires a deep understanding of consumer behavior, communication skills, and technical expertise.

NAME: Building Management System
DESCRIPTION: Building automation involves the integration of various building systems, including HVAC, lighting, security, and more, to create a unified and efficient management system. It requires specialized skills and knowledge in areas such as programming, networking, and system design. A building automation professional must possess the ability to assess a building's needs, design and implement systems that meet those needs, and ensure they work correctly and efficiently.

NAME: Building Codes
DESCRIPTION: Building codes are a set of regulations that must be followed when constructing or renovating a building in order to promote safety, accessibility, and energy efficiency. They vary by location and building type and are enforced by local government officials. Understanding building codes requires specialized knowledge of construction and building materials, as well as expertise in interpreting legal language and navigating the building permit process.

NAME: Construction
DESCRIPTION: Construction involves a specialized set of skills and knowledge, including an understanding of materials, structural engineering, and building codes. This field requires knowledge of construction techniques, tools, and industry-specific software. Construction workers also need to possess physical strength, stamina, dexterity, and problem-solving skills. Successful construction professionals must be able to collaborate with a team, communicate effectively, and have strong attention to detail.

NAME: Building Management
DESCRIPTION: Building Management refers to the process of overseeing and maintaining the physical and operational aspects of a building or facility. This skill encompasses the coordination of maintenance, security, and administrative functions to ensure the efficient operation of the property. Knowledge of Building Management is used to implement strategies for resource allocation, compliance with regulations, and the enhancement of tenant satisfaction through effective communication and problem-solving.

NAME: Electrical Wiring
DESCRIPTION: Electrical Wiring refers to the process of connecting electrical components and systems to enable the distribution of electricity within a structure. This skill encompasses knowledge of wiring techniques, safety standards, and electrical codes that ensure safe and efficient electrical installations. Electrical Wiring is used to install, maintain, and repair electrical systems in residential, commercial, and industrial settings, facilitating the operation of lighting, appliances, and other electrical devices.

NAME: Built Environment
DESCRIPTION: Built Environment refers to the human-made surroundings that provide the setting for human activity, encompassing buildings, infrastructure, and public spaces. This skill involves understanding the design, construction, and management of these environments to ensure functionality, sustainability, and safety. Knowledge of Built Environment is used to create spaces that meet the needs of communities while considering environmental impact, urban planning, and social dynamics. It enables the assessment and improvement of existing structures and the development of new projects that enhance quality of life.

NAME: Burn Down Charts
DESCRIPTION: A burn down chart is a graphical representation of the amount of work remaining to be done versus the time available to complete it. It is used in Agile project management to track the progress of the work completed and the remaining work within a given period. It requires a specialized skill to create and maintain burn down charts efficiently. The skill includes data analysis, project management, and software tools proficiency.

NAME: Business Acumen
DESCRIPTION: Business Acumen is the ability to understand and interpret business situations. It allows individuals to make informed decisions and effectively apply their business knowledge to achieve organizational objectives. This skill also plays a crucial role in driving sustainable growth by fostering effective relationships, both internally and externally, which are essential for an organization's success.

NAME: Business Administration
DESCRIPTION: Business administration involves managing the daily operations of a business, including finance, human resources, marketing, and strategic planning. This skill is essential for any person who wants to run or manage a business effectively. It involves creating and implementing policies and procedures that can help ensure the success of a company. Good business administrators are skilled communicators who can motivate and inspire their employees to work together towards a common goal. They are also adept at problem-solving and decision-making, which are crucial skills in business management.

NAME: Business Analytics
DESCRIPTION: Business Analytics refers to the practice of using data analysis and statistical methods to inform business decision-making. This skill encompasses the collection, processing, and interpretation of data to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can drive strategic initiatives. Knowledge of Business Analytics is used to enhance operational efficiency, improve customer experiences, and support data-driven strategies across various business functions.

NAME: Business Software
DESCRIPTION: Business Software refers to computer programs and applications specifically designed to support business processes, operations, and decision-making. This type of software can range from accounting software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems to customer relationship management (CRM) tools and project management software. The use of business software helps companies increase productivity, efficiency, and accuracy in their operations, as well as improve decision-making through data analysis and reporting.

NAME: Commercial Banking
DESCRIPTION: Commercial banking refers to a specialized skill set in the financial industry that involves serving the financial needs of businesses, corporations, and institutions. This includes providing financing solutions, managing cash flow, collecting deposits, and offering a variety of other services that help businesses operate more effectively. Commercial bankers must have a deep understanding of the unique demands of corporate customers and the ability to evaluate risk and make sound financial decisions. They must also possess strong analytical, communication, and customer service skills, as well as a commitment to ethical standards and professional integrity.

NAME: Business Case
DESCRIPTION: Business Case refers to a structured document that outlines the justification for a proposed project or initiative, detailing the benefits, costs, risks, and alternatives. This skill encompasses the ability to analyze and present data effectively to support decision-making processes. Knowledge of Business Case is used to evaluate the feasibility and potential impact of projects, enabling stakeholders to make informed choices regarding resource allocation and strategic direction.

NAME: Business Coaching
DESCRIPTION: Business Coaching refers to the process of guiding individuals or teams in a business context to enhance their performance and achieve specific goals. This skill involves assessing current practices, identifying areas for improvement, and developing strategies to foster growth and efficiency. Knowledge of Business Coaching is used to facilitate effective communication, decision-making, and problem-solving within organizations, ultimately leading to improved outcomes and increased productivity.

NAME: Business Communication
DESCRIPTION: Business Communication refers to the exchange of information and ideas within a professional context, encompassing various forms such as written, verbal, and non-verbal communication. This skill involves understanding the principles of effective communication, including clarity, conciseness, and audience awareness, which facilitate collaboration and decision-making in organizations. Knowledge of Business Communication is used to convey messages, present information, and foster relationships among stakeholders, ultimately contributing to organizational success and efficiency.

NAME: Management Consulting
DESCRIPTION: Management consulting is a specialized expertise that helps organizations improve their performance and effectiveness. It involves diagnosing and solving complex business problems, developing and implementing strategies, and providing guidance and expertise to senior leaders. Management consultants work with clients across a range of industries and functional areas, and often have specialized expertise in areas such as strategy, operations, human resources, or technology. The goal of management consulting is to help organizations become more efficient, innovative, and successful.

NAME: Business Continuity Planning
DESCRIPTION: Business Continuity Planning refers to the process of creating systems of prevention and recovery to deal with potential threats to an organization. This skill involves identifying critical business functions, assessing risks, and developing strategies to ensure that essential operations can continue during and after a disruption. Knowledge of Business Continuity Planning is used to create comprehensive plans that outline procedures for maintaining operations, safeguarding assets, and minimizing downtime in the event of emergencies or unforeseen incidents.

NAME: Internal Controls
DESCRIPTION: Internal Controls refers to the understanding and application of an organization's internal processes and systems designed to achieve operational efficiency, reliable financial reporting, and compliance with laws, regulations, and policies. This skill involves the ability to assess and improve these controls, ensuring they are effective in mitigating risks and promoting the organization's objectives. It also includes the ability to identify potential weaknesses or breaches in these controls, and to propose and implement necessary improvements.

NAME: Dashboard
DESCRIPTION: Dashboard is a software that provides real-time data visualizations and analytics to help businesses and organizations monitor their performance and make informed decisions. A dashboard can display key metrics, trends, and insights in an easy-to-understand format, allowing users to assess performance at a glance and take action based on the data presented. It requires specialized skills such as data analysis, data visualization, and software development.

NAME: Copy Editing
DESCRIPTION: Copy Editing involves reviewing and correcting written content to enhance clarity, coherence, and overall quality. This skill encompasses the identification and rectification of grammatical, punctuation, and spelling errors, as well as ensuring consistency in style and formatting. Knowledge of Copy Editing is utilized to refine documents, articles, and publications, thereby improving readability and ensuring adherence to established guidelines.

NAME: Business Ethics
DESCRIPTION: Business ethics is a form of applied ethics or professional ethics, that examines ethical principles and moral or ethical problems that can arise in a business environment. It applies to all aspects of business conduct and is relevant to the conduct of individuals and entire organizations. These ethics originate from individuals, organizational statements or the legal system. These norms, values, ethical, and unethical practices are the principles that guide a business.

NAME: Corporate Finance
DESCRIPTION: Corporate Finance refers to the management of a company's financial activities, focusing on maximizing shareholder value through long-term and short-term financial planning and the implementation of various strategies. This skill involves understanding and interpreting key financial indicators to evaluate the company's financial health and growth potential. It enables the user to make informed decisions about capital investment, budgeting, and financial risk management, contributing to the company's overall financial stability and growth.

NAME: Management Information Systems
DESCRIPTION: Management Information Systems refers to the integrated systems that collect, process, and analyze data to support decision-making within an organization. This skill encompasses the understanding of information technology, data management, and organizational processes, enabling effective communication and information flow. Knowledge of Management Information Systems is used to enhance operational efficiency, improve strategic planning, and facilitate data-driven decision-making across various business functions.

NAME: Business Intelligence Tools
DESCRIPTION: Business Intelligence Tools refer to the knowledge and application of software designed to retrieve, analyze, transform, and report data. These tools are used to provide insights into business operations, enabling data-driven decision making. They facilitate the understanding of trends, patterns, and insights in large data sets, contributing to strategic and operational business decisions.

NAME: Management
DESCRIPTION: Management is a set of skills that involve a variety of tasks, such as planning, organizing, leading, and controlling resources to achieve specific goals. It is a commonly required skill, applicable in various areas, including business, government, and non-profit organizations. A good manager must possess strong communication, decision-making, problem-solving, and leadership skills, and be able to adapt to different situations and work effectively with a team.

NAME: Business Mathematics
DESCRIPTION: Business Mathematics refers to the application of mathematical concepts and techniques to solve problems related to business operations and financial management. This skill encompasses areas such as calculations of interest, profit margins, budgeting, and statistical analysis, which enable informed decision-making and effective resource allocation. Knowledge of Business Mathematics is used to analyze financial data, forecast trends, and evaluate investment opportunities, thereby supporting strategic planning and operational efficiency.

NAME: Business Process
DESCRIPTION: Business Process refers to a set of structured activities or tasks that produce a specific service or product for a particular customer or customers. This skill encompasses the analysis, design, implementation, and optimization of processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness within an organization. Knowledge of Business Process is used to identify areas for improvement, streamline operations, and enhance overall performance by ensuring that resources are utilized effectively and objectives are met.

NAME: Business Process Modeling
DESCRIPTION: Business Process Modeling is the practice of creating visual representations of business processes to help organizations understand and improve their operations. It's a specialized skill that involves knowledge of process mapping techniques, business analysis methodologies, and modeling tools. BPM can help organizations identify inefficiencies, streamline workflows, and optimize resources. It requires analytical and critical-thinking skills, as well as the ability to communicate complex information in a clear and concise manner.

NAME: Business Networking
DESCRIPTION: Business Networking is the act of developing and maintaining relationships with other professionals and businesses, with the goal of expanding one's network of contacts and increasing opportunities for collaborations, referrals, and business growth. It requires a specialized set of skills, such as effective communication, active listening, and strategic thinking, and can be achieved through various channels, such as conferences, social media platforms, and professional organizations. Networking can help individuals and businesses build their reputation, gain new insights and knowledge, and establish valuable partnerships for success.

NAME: Strategic Planning
DESCRIPTION: Strategic planning is the process of setting a clear direction for an organization or project and mapping out the steps needed to achieve specific goals and objectives. It involves analyzing internal strengths and weaknesses, as well as external opportunities and threats, and making informed decisions about how to prioritize resources and allocate them effectively. Successful strategic planning requires a combination of creativity, critical thinking, and collaboration, as well as the ability to adapt to change and respond to feedback.

NAME: Business Partnering
DESCRIPTION: Business Partnering involves the capacity to influence and cultivate relationships within the business environment. Professionals with this skill possess the ability to understand and anticipate challenges affecting individuals in the organization. They collaborate with and challenge business leaders and stakeholders, translating operational needs into HR solutions that drive performance. DESCRIPTION: Business proposal writing is a common skill that involves presenting a formal document to a potential client, investor, or partner. The proposal typically outlines the goals, budget, timeline, and scope of the project or partnership. NAME: Business Relationship Management
DESCRIPTION: Business Relationship Management is a critical skill that focuses on building and maintaining relationships between businesses and their customers, suppliers, partners, and other stakeholders. It involves understanding the needs, goals, and expectations of these relationships, developing effective communication strategies, and fostering a culture of collaboration and mutual trust. Successful Business Relationship Management can lead to improved business performance, increased customer satisfaction, and greater success in achieving organizational objectives.

NAME: Business Reporting
DESCRIPTION: Business Reporting entails the ability to analyze information and generate organized documents and summaries tailored for a specific audience and purpose. Professionals with this skill excel in presenting information in a clear and comprehensible format, ensuring that the intended audience can easily grasp the key insights. This skill involves selecting the appropriate mode of delivery to effectively convey information, contributing to informed decision-making within an organization.

NAME: Business Requirements
DESCRIPTION: Business Requirements refer to the essential needs and expectations of stakeholders that must be met for a project or initiative to be considered successful. This skill involves gathering, analyzing, and documenting these requirements to ensure alignment between business objectives and project deliverables. Knowledge of Business Requirements is used to facilitate communication among stakeholders, guide project development, and ensure that the final outcomes meet the specified criteria and objectives.

NAME: Strategic Management
DESCRIPTION: Strategic Management refers to the process of formulating, implementing, and evaluating cross-functional decisions that enable an organization to achieve its long-term objectives. This skill encompasses the analysis of internal and external environments, resource allocation, and the establishment of competitive advantages. Knowledge of Strategic Management is used to guide organizations in navigating complex market dynamics, optimizing performance, and ensuring sustainable growth through effective planning and execution of strategies.

NAME: Business Studies
DESCRIPTION: Business Studies refers to the academic discipline that examines the principles and practices of business operations, management, and economics. This skill encompasses the analysis of organizational structures, financial systems, marketing strategies, and human resource management, enabling individuals to understand the complexities of business environments. Knowledge of Business Studies is used to inform decision-making, develop strategic plans, and enhance operational efficiency within various types of organizations.

NAME: Business Support Systems
DESCRIPTION: Business support systems refer to a set of specialized skills, technologies, and processes that help organizations manage their operations efficiently. These systems typically include software tools for enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), supply chain management (SCM), and other functions critical to business success. Professionals with expertise in business support systems can help organizations optimize their processes, leverage technology, and streamline operations, leading to improved performance and profitability.

NAME: Corporate Tax
DESCRIPTION: Corporate Tax refers to the understanding and application of direct income tax rules for corporations, both domestically and internationally. This skill involves the calculation, declaration, compliance, and payment of corporate taxes. It enables the accurate and timely fulfillment of tax obligations, ensuring legal compliance and financial accuracy for corporations.

NAME: Business Technologies
DESCRIPTION: Business Technologies refers to the integration of various technological tools and systems that support business operations and enhance productivity. This skill encompasses knowledge of software applications, data management, and digital communication platforms that facilitate efficient workflows and decision-making processes. Understanding Business Technologies is used to streamline operations, improve collaboration, and enable data-driven strategies within organizations.

NAME: Business Valuation
DESCRIPTION: Business Valuation refers to the process of determining the economic value of a business or company. This skill involves analyzing financial statements, market conditions, and industry trends to assess the worth of a business for purposes such as investment analysis, mergers and acquisitions, or financial reporting. Knowledge of Business Valuation is used to provide insights that inform decision-making, facilitate negotiations, and support strategic planning.

NAME: Business Workflow Analysis
DESCRIPTION: Business Workflow Analysis is the process of identifying, analyzing, and improving business processes to achieve efficiency, productivity, and effectiveness. The goal is to identify bottlenecks, redundancies, and inefficiencies in the workflow, and suggest improvements to streamline the process. This requires a deep understanding of the organization's structure, operations, and goals, as well as expertise in process mapping, data analysis, and problem-solving. A good workflow analysis can save time, reduce costs, improve customer satisfaction, and help organizations achieve their strategic objectives.

NAME: Consumer Behaviour
DESCRIPTION: Consumer behaviour is the study of how consumers make decisions about what products and services to buy. It involves understanding the psychological, social, and cultural factors that influence consumer choices. This specialized skill requires knowledge of research methods, data analysis techniques, and the ability to interpret and apply insights to marketing strategies. Understanding consumer behaviour is crucial for businesses to develop effective marketing strategies and remain competitive in today's market.

NAME: C# (Programming Language)
DESCRIPTION: C# is a programming language used to develop a variety of applications, including desktop, web, and gaming applications, as well as mobile apps for iOS and Android. It is commonly used in Microsoft's .NET framework and is known for its simplicity, powerful capabilities, and widespread use in the software industry. C# developers are in demand and can expect to earn competitive salaries.

NAME: Good Manufacturing Practices
DESCRIPTION: Good Manufacturing Practices refers to a set of guidelines and principles aimed at ensuring the consistent quality and safety of products in manufacturing processes. This skill encompasses knowledge of regulatory requirements, quality control measures, and operational procedures that minimize risks and enhance product integrity. Good Manufacturing Practices are used to establish standard operating procedures, conduct training, and implement quality assurance systems, thereby ensuring compliance with industry standards and protecting consumer health.

NAME: Unix
DESCRIPTION: Unix is an operating system that is commonly used in servers, mainframes, and workstations. It is known for its stability, reliability, and security features. Unix skills are in demand in industries such as IT, finance, healthcare, and government. Unix professionals typically work with command-line interface, shell scripting, networking, and system administration. Knowledge of Unix can also be useful for those who aspire to become software developers or data analysts.

NAME: C++ (Programming Language)
DESCRIPTION: C++ is a programming language commonly used for developing operating systems, browsers, games, and other complex software applications. It is an extension of the C programming language and includes features such as object-oriented programming, templates, and exception handling. Proficiency in C++ requires knowledge of its syntax, data types, control structures, memory management, and libraries.

NAME: Cabinetry
DESCRIPTION: Cabinetry refers to the craft of designing, constructing, and installing cabinets and other storage solutions, typically made from wood or composite materials. This skill involves knowledge of woodworking techniques, materials selection, and design principles to create functional and aesthetically pleasing storage units. Mastery of Cabinetry is utilized in residential and commercial settings to optimize space, enhance organization, and contribute to interior design by providing tailored storage solutions.

NAME: Calculations
DESCRIPTION: Calculations require a specialized skill set and a strong aptitude for mathematics. Individuals with this skill can accurately and efficiently perform complex mathematical equations and problem-solving tasks. This skill is highly valued in industries such as engineering, finance, and science, where precision and accuracy are essential.

NAME: Calibration
DESCRIPTION: Calibration refers to the process of adjusting and verifying the accuracy of measurement instruments and equipment to ensure they produce precise and reliable results. This skill involves comparing the output of a device to a known standard and making necessary adjustments to align the measurements with that standard. Knowledge of Calibration is used in various fields, including manufacturing, laboratory testing, and quality control, to maintain the integrity of measurements and ensure compliance with industry standards.

NAME: Call Center Experience
DESCRIPTION: Call center experience refers to the skill set and knowledge gained from working in a customer service role where one's primary responsibility is to communicate with customers via telephone, email, or chat. This specialized skill involves handling customer inquiries, complaints, and resolving issues in a timely and efficient manner, while maintaining a friendly and professional demeanor. Call center experience also includes familiarity with call center software and technologies, as well as understanding of customer service metrics and targets.

NAME: Computer-Aided Manufacturing
DESCRIPTION: Computer-Aided Manufacturing refers to the use of software and computer systems to facilitate and enhance manufacturing processes. This skill encompasses the design, planning, and control of production activities through the integration of computer technology, enabling precision and efficiency in the creation of products. Knowledge of Computer-Aided Manufacturing is applied in various industries to streamline operations, reduce waste, and improve product quality by automating tasks such as machining, assembly, and inspection.

NAME: Cancer
DESCRIPTION: Cancer refers to the complex nature of cancer treatment and care, which requires a high level of expertise from healthcare professionals. Because cancer is a complex disease that affects multiple systems in the body and requires highly specialized treatments, doctors and other healthcare professionals need specific knowledge and training to provide effective care for cancer patients. This includes understanding the different types of cancer, the latest treatment options, and how to effectively manage the many challenges that arise during cancer treatment. Overall, providing quality cancer care requires a specialized skillset and a dedicated team of healthcare professionals.

NAME: Ubuntu (Operating System)
DESCRIPTION: Ubuntu is a free and open-source operating system based on the Linux kernel. It is typically used on desktop and server computers, as well as IoT devices and cloud computing. Ubuntu provides a user-friendly interface and a wide range of pre-installed software, making it a popular choice for both personal and professional use. It is constantly updated with new features and security updates, ensuring a reliable and stable system for users.

NAME: Corrective And Preventive Action (CAPA)
DESCRIPTION: Corrective And Preventive Action (CAPA) refers to a systematic approach used to identify, investigate, and resolve issues that may lead to nonconformities in processes or products. This skill involves analyzing root causes of problems and implementing corrective actions to address them, as well as preventive measures to avoid recurrence. Knowledge of CAPA is utilized in various industries to enhance quality management systems, ensure compliance with regulations, and improve overall operational efficiency.

NAME: IT Capacity Management
DESCRIPTION: Capacity management is the process of ensuring that businesses have adequate resources and infrastructure to meet current and future demands. It involves analyzing and evaluating the capacity of different resources, such as people, equipment, technology, and space, and determining how to optimize their use. Effective capacity management requires specialized skills in areas such as data analysis, forecasting, and resource planning, and it plays a critical role in supporting business growth and success.

NAME: Capacity Planning
DESCRIPTION: Capacity planning is a process of forecasting and allocating resources to meet the evolving needs of an organization. It involves the creation of a long-term plan to ensure that a company has the necessary capacity to sustain its growth and deliver products and services to customers. Capacity planners work to identify bottlenecks, optimize resources, and ensure that the necessary resources are available when needed. Successful capacity planning requires a combination of technical expertise, analytical skills, and business acumen.

NAME: Capital Expenditure
DESCRIPTION: Capital Expenditure refers to the funds used by an organization to acquire, upgrade, or maintain physical assets such as property, buildings, machinery, and equipment. This skill encompasses the analysis and planning of long-term investments that are essential for the growth and sustainability of a business. Knowledge of Capital Expenditure is used to evaluate potential projects, assess their financial viability, and ensure that resources are allocated effectively to maximize returns on investment.

NAME: Investments
DESCRIPTION: Investing involves making decisions about how to allocate resources in order to generate returns. It is a complex and specialized skill that requires knowledge of financial markets, economics, and business strategy, as well as an understanding of risk and the ability to analyze data and make informed decisions. Successful investors must be able to identify and evaluate potential investments, manage their portfolios, and adjust their strategies as market conditions change. Due to its complexity, many individuals choose to work with professional financial advisers or asset managers to help them achieve their investment goals.

NAME: Capital Markets
DESCRIPTION: Capital Markets refer to the financial markets where long-term debt or equity-backed securities are bought and sold. This skill encompasses the understanding of market structures, instruments, and regulatory frameworks that facilitate the raising of capital for businesses and governments. Knowledge of Capital Markets is used to analyze investment opportunities, assess risk, and make informed decisions regarding asset allocation and portfolio management.

NAME: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)
DESCRIPTION: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) refers to a life-saving technique used in emergencies when someone's breathing or heartbeat has stopped. This skill involves a combination of chest compressions and rescue breaths to maintain blood flow and oxygenation to vital organs until professional medical help arrives. Knowledge of Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) is essential for responding effectively to cardiac arrest situations, thereby increasing the chances of survival for the affected individual.

NAME: Cardiac Stress Testing
DESCRIPTION: Cardiac stress testing is a specialized medical procedure that involves the use of technology and equipment to evaluate how well the heart responds to physical activity. It is typically performed by trained professionals in a clinical or hospital setting and involves monitoring a patient's heart rate, blood pressure, and other vital signs during exercise or other physical stress. The results of cardiac stress testing can help doctors diagnose and manage a wide range of cardiovascular conditions, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias.

NAME: Nursing Homes
