This skill encompasses the design, development, and deployment of applications that utilize web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to provide dynamic user experiences. Knowledge of Web Applications is used to create platforms for various purposes, including e-commerce, social networking, and content management, by enabling user interaction and data processing in real-time.

NAME: Web Application Development
DESCRIPTION: Web Application Development refers to the process of creating software applications that run on web browsers, enabling users to interact with the application over the internet. This skill encompasses various stages, including planning, design, coding, testing, and deployment, utilizing programming languages, frameworks, and databases. Knowledge of Web Application Development is used to build responsive and dynamic applications that meet user needs, facilitate data management, and enhance user experience across different devices and platforms.

NAME: Web Banner
DESCRIPTION: Web banner design involves creating graphical elements that are intended to promote a specific product, service or event online. It requires specialized skills such as graphic design, web development, and marketing. Effective web banner design involves capturing attention, conveying a message, and motivating the viewer to take a specific action.

NAME: Web Navigation
DESCRIPTION: Web navigation refers to the act of browsing and exploring web pages and websites on the internet. It is a common skill that involves using web browsers, navigating menus and links, searching for information, and using site maps, among other techniques. Effective web navigation can improve productivity, facilitate information access, and enhance user experience. It is an important aspect of digital literacy and essential for individuals in various professions and industries, including marketing, e-commerce, and content creation.

NAME: Web Pages
DESCRIPTION: Web pages development is the process of designing and creating visual content and written copy for web pages that are both aesthetically appealing and easily navigable, helping businesses and individuals attract and retain visitors to their websites. It requires technical expertise and knowledge of programming languages, as well as artistic sensibility and marketing skills to create a compelling user experience.

NAME: Web Platforms
DESCRIPTION: Web Platforms refer to the frameworks and technologies that facilitate the development, deployment, and management of web applications and services. This skill encompasses knowledge of various programming languages, content management systems, and server architectures that enable the creation of interactive and dynamic websites. Understanding Web Platforms is used to design user interfaces, manage databases, and ensure compatibility across different devices and browsers, thereby enhancing user experience and functionality.

NAME: Web Services
DESCRIPTION: Web Services refer to a standardized way of integrating web-based applications using open standards over an internet protocol backbone. This skill encompasses the use of protocols and tools that enable different applications to communicate and share data seamlessly, regardless of the platforms they are built on. Knowledge of Web Services is used to develop and implement APIs, facilitate data exchange, and support interoperability between diverse systems and applications.

NAME: WebSocket
DESCRIPTION: WebSocket is a computer communications protocol that enables bidirectional communication between a web browser and a server over a single, long-standing connection. It allows real-time data transfer between the client and server without the need for repetitive HTTP requests. This technology is used for developing real-time web applications and games, chatting applications, and online collaboration tools. Expertise in WebSocket includes setup and configuration, development, and troubleshooting of WebSocket-powered applications.

NAME: Web Standards
DESCRIPTION: Web Standards refer to a set of best practices and guidelines for building websites that ensure compatibility, accessibility, and usability across different web browsers and devices. It requires specialized skill sets in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other web development languages. Adhering to web standards can improve website performance, search engine rankings, and user experience.

NAME: Web Traffic
DESCRIPTION: Web Traffic refers to the volume of data sent and received by visitors to a website, which is a critical metric for assessing online presence and engagement. This skill involves analyzing patterns of user behavior, including the sources of traffic, user demographics, and interaction with content. Knowledge of Web Traffic is used to inform strategies for content creation, marketing campaigns, and website optimization, ultimately enhancing user experience and achieving organizational goals.

NAME: Website Builder
DESCRIPTION: Website Builder is a software tool that allows individuals or businesses to create and design their own website without needing to have any prior knowledge of coding or web development. It provides templates, drag-and-drop editors, and various customization options to easily build a website that meets specific needs and requirements. This allows non-technical people to create visually appealing and functional websites with ease.

NAME: Website Management
DESCRIPTION: Website Management refers to the process of overseeing and maintaining a website to ensure its functionality, performance, and security. This skill encompasses tasks such as content updates, user experience optimization, and technical troubleshooting, which are essential for providing a seamless online presence. Knowledge of Website Management is used to monitor website analytics, implement design changes, and manage hosting services, thereby enhancing user engagement and achieving organizational goals.

NAME: Wireframing
SUBCATEGORY_NAME: User Interface and User Experience (UI/UX) Design
DESCRIPTION: Wireframing refers to the process of creating a visual blueprint of a digital product, outlining its structure, layout, and functionality. This skill involves the use of basic shapes and lines to represent elements such as buttons, navigation, and content areas, enabling clear communication of design ideas. Knowledge of Wireframing is utilized to facilitate discussions among stakeholders, guide the development process, and ensure that user experience considerations are integrated into the final product design.

NAME: Weed Control
DESCRIPTION: Weed Control refers to the management and elimination of unwanted plants that compete with cultivated crops for resources. This skill encompasses various methods, including mechanical, chemical, and cultural practices, aimed at reducing weed populations and minimizing their impact on agricultural productivity. Knowledge of Weed Control is used to implement effective strategies that promote healthy crop growth while maintaining ecological balance.

NAME: Wholesaling
DESCRIPTION: Wholesaling is the practice of buying goods in bulk from manufacturers or distributors and reselling them to retailers or other businesses at a profit. It involves negotiating prices, managing inventory, and building relationships with suppliers and buyers. Successful wholesalers must have a deep understanding of the market, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to forecast demand and manage risk.

NAME: Wind Turbines
DESCRIPTION: Wind Turbines refer to devices that convert kinetic energy from wind into mechanical energy, which can then be transformed into electrical energy. This skill encompasses knowledge of turbine design, installation, operation, and maintenance, enabling efficient energy production from renewable sources. Understanding Wind Turbines is utilized to assess site suitability, optimize performance, and ensure reliability in energy generation systems.

NAME: Microsoft Intune (Mobile Device Management Software)
DESCRIPTION: Microsoft Intune is a mobile device management software developed by Microsoft that allows users to manage and monitor their mobile devices, including smartphones, tablets, and laptops. It provides features like device enrollment, policies management, app deployment, and remote wipe capabilities. With Microsoft Intune, organizations can ensure the security and compliance of corporate data and applications on employee's mobile devices.

NAME: Windows Server Update Services
DESCRIPTION: Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) is a software tool that allows system administrators to manage and distribute updates and patches for Microsoft Windows operating systems and other Microsoft products. This centralized approach streamlines the process of deploying updates across multiple computers on a network, ensuring that all systems are properly protected against security vulnerabilities and other issues. A WSUS administrator must have knowledge of WSUS server installation and configuration, update distribution, client configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

NAME: Wireless Communications
DESCRIPTION: Wireless communications refer to the transfer of information between two or more devices using electromagnetic waves without the need for physical wires or cables. This skill entails designing, implementing, and troubleshooting wireless networks, including setting up wireless access points, configuring security measures, and optimizing network performance. It also involves understanding wireless communication technologies such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and cellular networks, as well as their associated protocols, standards, and limitations. Efficient use and management of wireless communications are essential in various industries and contexts, including telecommunications, IT, healthcare, and transportation.

NAME: Mitigation

Knowledge of Mitigation is used to develop plans and actions that address vulnerabilities, enhance resilience, and promote sustainable practices in various fields, including disaster management, public health, and environmental conservation.

NAME: Catalogues
DESCRIPTION: Cataloguing is the process of organizing, describing, and classifying items in a collection, such as a library or museum. It requires a specialized skill set that includes knowledge of cataloging standards and systems, as well as attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Cataloguers must also be able to navigate complex databases and search engines in order to accurately and efficiently create records for items in a collection. Ultimately, their work helps to make collections accessible and discoverable for researchers and the general public.

NAME: Trauma Care
DESCRIPTION: Trauma Care refers to the assessment and treatment of individuals who have experienced physical or psychological trauma. This skill encompasses the application of medical and psychological interventions to stabilize patients, manage pain, and address emotional distress. Knowledge of Trauma Care is used to implement appropriate emergency response strategies, facilitate recovery, and support individuals in coping with the aftermath of traumatic events.

NAME: Texturing
DESCRIPTION: Texturing refers to the process of creating surface details and visual characteristics on 3D models to enhance realism and depth. This skill involves applying various materials, colors, and patterns to objects, which enables the user to simulate different surfaces such as wood, metal, or fabric. Knowledge of Texturing is used in fields such as animation, video game design, and architectural visualization to improve the aesthetic quality and visual storytelling of digital content.

NAME: International Residential Codes
DESCRIPTION: The International Residential Codes (IRC) is a set of standards and guidelines that govern the construction and design of residential buildings. It covers areas such as building materials, structural requirements, plumbing systems, electrical systems, and fire safety. Understanding and applying the IRC requires specialized knowledge and skills in the areas of construction, engineering, and architecture. Compliance with IRC standards ensures that residential buildings are safe, efficient, and soundly built.

NAME: Graphing
DESCRIPTION: Graphing refers to the visual representation of data using various types of charts and plots, which facilitates the understanding of relationships and trends within the data. This skill encompasses the ability to select appropriate graph types, accurately plot data points, and interpret the resulting visualizations. Knowledge of Graphing is used to analyze quantitative information in fields such as mathematics, science, and economics, enabling clearer communication of complex data insights.

NAME: Critical Care
DESCRIPTION: Critical care is a specialized area of healthcare that involves the care of critically ill patients who require constant monitoring and intervention. It requires a team of highly trained healthcare professionals who are skilled in assessing, diagnosing, and managing complex medical conditions. Critical care may take place in specialized units, such as the ICU, and often involves the use of advanced medical technology and equipment. The goal of critical care is to stabilize patients and help them recover from their illness or injury.

NAME: Commissioning
DESCRIPTION: Commissioning refers to the process of ensuring that systems and components of a facility are designed, installed, tested, and operated according to the specified requirements. This skill involves verifying performance, functionality, and safety standards through systematic testing and documentation. Knowledge of Commissioning is used to facilitate the successful handover of projects, ensuring that all systems operate efficiently and meet operational criteria before full-scale use. It plays a critical role in various industries, including construction, manufacturing, and energy, by enhancing reliability and performance of systems.

NAME: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
DESCRIPTION: Identity Services Engine (ISE) is a software developed by Cisco which provides network access control and policy enforcement functionalities. ISE facilitates secure network access using authentication and authorization policies that govern network devices, users, and applications. It enables unified policy management for both wired and wireless networks, simplifying policy creation and enforcement across multiple devices and platforms. With ISE, organizations can enforce security policies to protect their networks against unauthorized access and threats.

NAME: Metal Inert Gas (MIG) Welding
DESCRIPTION: Metal Inert Gas (MIG) Welding refers to a welding process that utilizes a continuous wire feed as an electrode and an inert gas to shield the weld from contamination. This skill involves the application of heat generated by an electric arc to melt and join metal components, ensuring strong and durable connections. Knowledge of Metal Inert Gas (MIG) Welding is used in various industries to fabricate and repair metal structures, enabling efficient and precise welding in both thin and thick materials.

NAME: Autodesk Mechanical Desktop
DESCRIPTION: Autodesk Mechanical Desktop is a computer-aided design (CAD) software application that allows users to create 3D mechanical designs and simulations. It has a range of tools for creating and editing 3D models, assemblies, and drawings. This software is commonly used in engineering, manufacturing, and product design industries to develop complex industrial designs and prototypes. It is also useful for analyzing and testing the functionality of these designs to ensure they meet specific requirements. The software is known for its flexible modeling capabilities, design automation, and integration with other Autodesk products.

NAME: Persistence
DESCRIPTION: Persistence is a common skill that can be developed and practiced by anyone. It involves the ability to keep working towards goals in the face of challenges, setbacks, and failures. To build persistence, individuals can focus on developing a growth mindset, breaking large goals into smaller, achievable steps, being flexible in their approach, and seeking support when needed. With practice, persistence can become a habit and lead to greater success and fulfillment in all areas of life.

NAME: Batteries
DESCRIPTION: Batteries refers to the knowledge and handling of electrochemical devices that store and supply electrical energy. This skill involves understanding the types, capacities, and appropriate usage of batteries, including their installation, maintenance, and disposal. It is used to ensure reliable power supply in various applications, from portable electronics to large-scale energy storage systems.

NAME: Booking (Sales)
DESCRIPTION: Booking or sales involves the process of persuading clients to purchase a product or service. It requires a specialized skill set that includes effective communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to understand and anticipate customer needs. A successful booking or sales professional must also have a good understanding of their product or service and be able to tailor their approach to suit different customers and situations.

NAME: Demonstration Skills
DESCRIPTION: Demonstration skills refer to the ability to effectively showcase or illustrate a product, concept, or process through a live or video presentation. This specialized skill involves expertise in preparing, organizing, and delivering demonstrations that effectively engage the audience and meet specific objectives. This may include skills such as effective communication, attention to detail, adaptability, and an ability to handle unexpected situations. Successful demonstration skills are essential in fields such as sales, marketing, education, and training.

NAME: Standard Template Library (STL)
DESCRIPTION: STL is a C++ library that provides a set of reusable algorithms, data structures, and functions commonly used in software development. It includes containers like vectors, lists, and maps, as well as algorithms for sorting, searching, and manipulating these containers. STL is known for providing efficient and easy-to-use tools for program development and is widely used in software development.

NAME: Resourcing
DESCRIPTION: Resourcing refers to the process of identifying, allocating, and managing the necessary assets, materials, and personnel required to complete a project or achieve specific objectives. This skill encompasses the assessment of resource availability, planning for optimal utilization, and ensuring that all components are effectively coordinated. Knowledge of Resourcing is used to enhance project efficiency, minimize waste, and ensure that timelines and budgets are adhered to by strategically aligning resources with project demands.

Mastery of this skill ensures optimal surface treatment and durability.

NAME: Political Action Committee (PAC)

Knowledge of Political Action Committees is used to analyze political landscapes, develop funding strategies, and engage in advocacy efforts that align with the committee's objectives.

NAME: Cooling Systems
DESCRIPTION: Cooling systems refer to a set of components and processes that work together to regulate and reduce the temperature of a device or space. This can include air conditioning systems for buildings, refrigeration systems for food and beverages, and cooling systems for electronic devices. Managing and maintaining these systems requires specialized knowledge and expertise, as well as a deep understanding of thermodynamics, physics, and engineering principles. A skilled technician in the field of cooling systems must be able to diagnose, repair, and optimize these systems to ensure they are operating efficiently and effectively.

NAME: Public Affairs
DESCRIPTION: Public Affairs is a strategic communication skill that focuses on building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders who have an interest in an organisation's operations. This skill involves understanding and managing the perspectives of various stakeholders such as politicians, customers, local communities, shareholders, trade associations, and think tanks. It is used to foster a positive image of the organisation, facilitate open communication, and ensure that the organisation's actions align with stakeholder expectations and societal norms.

NAME: Branding
DESCRIPTION: Branding is a strategic marketing skill that involves the creation and management of a unique identity for a product, service, or organization. It involves the use of marketing knowledge to articulate a differentiated positioning, aligning it with the overall brand guidelines and value proposition. This skill is crucial in attracting the best talent and establishing a strong, recognizable presence in the market.

NAME: Reservations
DESCRIPTION: Reservations is the process of making arrangements or bookings for a specific service or event in advance. It involves coordinating and confirming various details, such as timing, location, and cost, to ensure a smooth and successful experience. Reservations can relate to many different areas, including travel, dining, accommodations, and entertainment. It is a useful and necessary skill for both individuals and businesses to ensure that plans are well-organized and executed effectively.

NAME: Competitive Analysis
DESCRIPTION: Competitive Analysis is a strategic skill that involves the evaluation and comparison of the strengths and weaknesses of competing entities. It is used to identify gaps, assess features, and understand the competitive landscape in a specific market or industry. This skill aids in making informed decisions, developing effective strategies, and identifying potential opportunities and threats.

NAME: Instructing
DESCRIPTION: Instructing refers to the process of teaching or providing guidance to individuals or groups in order to facilitate learning and skill development. This skill involves the ability to convey information clearly, design effective learning experiences, and assess understanding to ensure knowledge retention. Knowledge of Instructing is used to enhance educational outcomes in various settings, such as classrooms, training programs, and workshops, by adapting methods to meet the needs of diverse learners.

NAME: Collections
DESCRIPTION: Collections is the process of recovering outstanding debts from clients or customers who have not paid their bills on time. This involves contacting them via phone, email, or mail to negotiate payment plans or repayment schedules. It requires strong communication, negotiation, and organizational skills, as well as an understanding of relevant laws and regulations. Collections is a common skill needed in a variety of industries, from banking and finance to healthcare and retail.

NAME: Application-Specific Information
DESCRIPTION: Application-Specific Information refers to data and knowledge tailored to particular applications or systems, providing context and relevance for their effective use. This skill involves understanding the unique requirements, functionalities, and constraints of specific applications, enabling users to make informed decisions and optimize performance. Application-Specific Information is utilized to enhance user experience, troubleshoot issues, and ensure that applications meet their intended objectives efficiently.

NAME: Sound Systems
DESCRIPTION: Sound systems require technical knowledge and specialized skills to setup, operate, and troubleshoot. This involves understanding acoustics, audio signals, different types of equipment, and the ability to adjust various settings to create optimal sound quality. A professional in the field typically has experience in sound engineering, which includes installing, configuring, and managing sound systems for live events or recording sessions.

NAME: Filing
DESCRIPTION: Filing is the process of organizing, categorizing and storing documents and records in a systematic and easily retrievable manner. It is a crucial skill in maintaining order and efficiency in workplaces, schools, and homes. Proper filing techniques involve labeling, grouping, and prioritizing documents based on their importance and usage frequency. Filing can be done electronically or manually, and it requires attention to detail, accuracy, and consistency.

NAME: Dispatching
DESCRIPTION: Dispatching refers to the process of coordinating and managing the movement of resources, such as vehicles or personnel, to ensure timely and efficient service delivery. This skill involves assessing requests, prioritizing tasks, and communicating with relevant parties to optimize routes and schedules. Knowledge of Dispatching is used to enhance operational efficiency in various sectors, including transportation, emergency services, and logistics, by effectively allocating resources and monitoring progress.

NAME: Backlogs
DESCRIPTION: Backlogs refer to a collection of tasks, projects, or work items that have been identified but not yet completed or addressed. This skill involves the ability to prioritize, manage, and track these items to ensure efficient workflow and resource allocation. Knowledge of Backlogs is used to facilitate project management processes, enabling teams to focus on high-priority tasks and maintain productivity by systematically addressing outstanding work. Effective management of Backlogs contributes to improved project timelines and overall operational efficiency.

NAME: Invision (Design Software)
DESCRIPTION: InVision is a digital product design platform used by designers to create, prototype, and collaborate on user interfaces (UIs). It allows designers to create wireframes, high fidelity prototypes, animations, and design systems. InVision is used by product teams at companies such as Uber, IBM, and Airbnb.

NAME: Traffic Patterns
DESCRIPTION: Traffic Patterns refer to the analysis and understanding of the movement and flow of vehicles and pedestrians within a specific area. This skill encompasses the study of various factors influencing traffic, such as road design, traffic signals, and peak usage times. Knowledge of Traffic Patterns is used to improve transportation planning, enhance road safety, and optimize traffic management strategies by identifying congestion points and proposing effective solutions.

NAME: Load Balancing
DESCRIPTION: Load balancing is the process of distributing traffic that comes to a website or application across multiple servers or resources to optimize performance and ensure high availability. It requires specialized skills and knowledge in server administration, networking, and security. Load balancing can improve website speed and reliability by preventing server overload and minimizing downtime caused by server failure or maintenance. An efficient load balancing system can help organizations save costs, improve customer satisfaction, and enhance the overall user experience.

NAME: Balancing (Ledger/Billing)
DESCRIPTION: Balancing (Ledger/Billing) refers to the process of ensuring that financial records, such as ledgers and billing statements, are accurate and in agreement. This skill involves reconciling discrepancies between recorded transactions and actual financial data to maintain integrity in financial reporting. Knowledge of Balancing (Ledger/Billing) is used to verify account balances, identify errors, and ensure compliance with financial regulations, thereby supporting effective financial management and decision-making.

NAME: Interior Decorating
DESCRIPTION: Interior Decorating involves the art and science of enhancing the interior of a space to achieve a healthier and more aesthetically pleasing environment. This skill encompasses the selection of color schemes, furniture, fixtures, and accessories, as well as the arrangement of these elements to create a cohesive design. Knowledge of Interior Decorating is used to transform residential and commercial spaces by improving functionality, comfort, and visual appeal while reflecting the preferences and needs of the occupants.

NAME: Data Storage
DESCRIPTION: Data Storage refers to the ability to efficiently and securely store, manage, and retrieve digital information. This skill involves understanding various storage technologies such as cloud storage, databases, and data warehouses. It also includes knowledge of data backup, recovery, archiving, and protection strategies. Proficiency in data storage requires familiarity with data storage systems, data lifecycle management, and compliance with data privacy regulations.

NAME: Reliability
DESCRIPTION: Reliability refers to the consistent ability to perform tasks, fulfill obligations, and meet expectations over time. It involves dependability, accuracy, and consistency in actions and results. This skill is used to build trust, maintain standards, and ensure that tasks are completed efficiently and on schedule.

NAME: Requirements Specifications
DESCRIPTION: Requirements Specifications refer to the detailed documentation of the needs and expectations for a project or system. This skill involves gathering, analyzing, and articulating the functional and non-functional requirements that guide the development process. Knowledge of Requirements Specifications is used to ensure that all stakeholders have a clear understanding of the project objectives, facilitating effective communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle. It serves as a foundation for design, development, and validation activities, helping to ensure that the final product meets the specified criteria.

NAME: Health Reimbursement Arrangement
DESCRIPTION: Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) is a type of tax-advantaged benefit plan that allows employers to reimburse employees for qualified medical expenses. HRAs can be tailored to meet the specific needs of the employer and employees, offering flexibility and cost savings. Employers can use the funds to help offset the cost of deductibles, copays, and other out-of-pocket expenses. HRA administration requires specialized knowledge and expertise in employee benefits, tax law, and insurance regulations.

NAME: Transcribing
DESCRIPTION: Transcribing is the process of converting an audio or video recording into a written document. It involves listening to the recording and typing out the spoken words, often with careful attention to grammar and punctuation. Transcription is a common skill that is valued in a range of fields, including journalism, legal services, and market research. Good transcriptionists should have excellent listening skills, an eye for detail, and enough typing speed to keep up with the recording.

NAME: Prioritization
DESCRIPTION: Prioritization is the ability to effectively plan and prioritize by assessing the relative importance and urgency of a task, activity, or event. This skill involves the capacity to adjust priorities when appropriate, ensuring that deadlines are met, and that organizational goals are not adversely impacted. Prioritization is crucial for time management and resource allocation, enabling individuals and organizations to focus on what matters most and achieve their objectives efficiently.

NAME: Hardening
DESCRIPTION: Hardening is the process of making computer systems and networks more secure against potential threats by enhancing the security features and reducing the vulnerabilities. It requires specialized skills and knowledge of security protocols, hardware and software configurations, and network infrastructure. The objective of hardening is to maximize the protection of information, data, and system resources from unauthorized access, attacks, and breaches. It involves implementing security measures such as firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, encryption, access controls, and authentication mechanisms.

NAME: Component Object Model (COM)
DESCRIPTION: Component Object Model (COM) is a software technology developed by Microsoft to facilitate communication and interaction between software components or objects. COM allows software components to be developed independently, then freely combined and reused to create larger, more complex applications. COM facilitates inter-process communication, including sharing of data and functions, and provides a standardized interface for accessing objects. COM is widely used in Windows operating systems and related software development environments.

NAME: Advising
DESCRIPTION: Advising, also known as mentoring or counseling, is a common skill that involves providing guidance, support, and recommendations to individuals who require advice or assistance in personal or professional matters. Advising requires effective communication skills, active listening, empathy, problem-solving skills, and a deep understanding of the individual's needs, goals, and challenges. Good advisors help their clients set realistic goals, develop action plans, and navigate challenges, while respecting individual differences and cultural backgrounds. Successful advising helps individuals build confidence, enhance their skills, and achieve their goals.

NAME: Doppler Ultrasonography
DESCRIPTION: Doppler ultrasonography is a specialized medical imaging technique that uses sound waves to evaluate blood flow in the arteries and veins. It is typically performed by trained radiologists or sonographers, and the results can help diagnose various conditions that affect blood flow, such as peripheral artery disease, deep vein thrombosis, and fetal distress during pregnancy. Doppler ultrasonography requires specialized equipment and technical expertise, and is generally considered a safe and noninvasive diagnostic tool.

NAME: Performance Testing
DESCRIPTION: Performance Testing refers to the process of evaluating the speed, scalability, and stability of a system under various conditions. This skill involves executing tests to measure response times, throughput, and resource utilization, ensuring that applications can handle expected user loads. Knowledge of Performance Testing is used to identify bottlenecks, optimize system performance, and enhance user experience by providing insights into system behavior under stress.

NAME: Consolidation
DESCRIPTION: Consolidation is a complex financial process that involves combining financial statements of different subsidiaries or entities into a single, unified report. It requires a specialized skill set that includes knowledge of accounting principles, financial analysis, and reporting requirements. The process helps organizations get a more accurate picture of their financial performance by eliminating intercompany transactions and creating a consolidated view of the company's financial position. It is important that consolidation is done correctly to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and to make informed business decisions.

NAME: Serial Peripheral Interface
DESCRIPTION: Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI) is a communication protocol used to connect multiple devices, such as microcontrollers and sensors, to a single master device. It is a synchronous protocol that enables fast and reliable data transfer between devices using four wires: a clock signal, a data input, a data output, and a chip select signal. SPI is commonly used in embedded systems and requires specialized knowledge and skills to implement effectively.

NAME: Grading (Landscape)
DESCRIPTION: Grading (Landscape) refers to the process of modifying the slope and elevation of land to achieve desired drainage, aesthetics, and functionality in outdoor spaces. This skill involves assessing the topography and soil conditions to create a stable and visually appealing landscape design. Knowledge of Grading (Landscape) is used to ensure proper water flow, prevent erosion, and facilitate the installation of features such as pathways, gardens, and structures within a landscape. Techniques employed in this skill include excavation, filling, and contouring to meet specific project requirements.

NAME: SUSE Linux
DESCRIPTION: SUSE Linux refers to a Linux distribution developed by SUSE, designed for enterprise environments and known for its stability and security features. This skill encompasses knowledge of system administration, configuration, and management of SUSE Linux servers and workstations. Proficiency in SUSE Linux is used to deploy applications, manage system resources, and ensure system integrity through updates and security patches. Understanding SUSE Linux also enables users to troubleshoot issues and optimize performance in various computing environments.

NAME: Differentials
DESCRIPTION: Differentials is a specialized mathematical skill that involves finding the instantaneous rate of change in a function at a specific point. It is commonly used in calculus and related fields to solve problems related to optimization, motion, and change. The process involves calculating the limit of the difference quotient, which is the change in the output divided by the change in the input as the change in input approaches zero. This skill requires a solid understanding of calculus and mathematical concepts such as limits and derivatives.

NAME: Test-Driven Development (TDD)
DESCRIPTION: Test-Driven Development (TDD) is a software development approach where developers write automated tests before writing the actual code. The goal is to improve software quality and reduce errors by catching them early in the development process. TDD is considered a specialized skill because it requires strong programming skills, knowledge of testing frameworks, and the ability to write clean and scalable code. Developers who are skilled in TDD can deliver high-quality software that meets customer requirements and industry standards.

NAME: Workplace Safety
DESCRIPTION: Workplace safety requires specialized knowledge, skills and expertise to identify and assess hazards in the workplace, develop safety programs and policies, and implement safety practices and procedures that ensure the well-being of employees, customers and the general public. Effective workplace safety professionals must have a thorough understanding of occupational safety and health regulations, risk management principles, and emergency preparedness and response strategies.

NAME: Influenza
DESCRIPTION: Influenza refers to a contagious viral infection that primarily affects the respiratory system, characterized by symptoms such as fever, cough, and body aches. This skill encompasses understanding the transmission, prevention, and treatment of the influenza virus, which is essential for public health management. Knowledge of Influenza is used to implement vaccination programs, develop treatment protocols, and educate communities on preventive measures to reduce the spread of the virus.

NAME: Chatbot
DESCRIPTION: Chatbot refers to a software application designed to simulate human conversation through text or voice interactions. This skill encompasses the development and implementation of algorithms and natural language processing techniques that enable automated responses to user inquiries. Knowledge of Chatbot is used to enhance customer service, provide information, and facilitate user engagement across various platforms by managing interactions and delivering relevant content efficiently.

NAME: Data Science
DESCRIPTION: Data Science refers to the interdisciplinary field that utilizes scientific methods, algorithms, and systems to extract knowledge and insights from structured and unstructured data. This skill encompasses data collection, cleaning, analysis, and visualization techniques that enable informed decision-making and predictive modeling. Knowledge of Data Science is used to address complex problems across various domains, including healthcare, finance, and marketing, by uncovering patterns and trends within data sets.

NAME: Data Ingestion
DESCRIPTION: Data ingestion is the process of collecting and importing data from various sources into a storage system or a data warehouse. It requires specialized skills to ensure the data is accurate, consistent, and organized. The process involves extracting data from multiple sources in different formats and transforming it into a standard format that can be used for analysis. This process is essential for businesses to obtain insights that can help drive informed decisions. Proper data ingestion helps ensure data accuracy, reduce data redundancy and improve data quality.

NAME: Postman API Platform
DESCRIPTION: Postman API Platform is a software application used for API development, testing, collaboration, and documentation. It simplifies the process of designing, testing, and sharing APIs by providing tools for creating and managing API requests, organizing and sharing collections of requests, and generating API documentation. Postman API Platform also supports team collaboration, allowing team members to work together on API development and testing projects. As a specialized skill, proficiency in Postman API Platform involves knowledge of API fundamentals and the ability to design, test, and document RESTful APIs.

NAME: Product Strategy
DESCRIPTION: Product Strategy refers to the process of defining a product's vision, goals, and roadmap to meet market needs and drive business success. This skill involves analyzing market trends, customer feedback, and competitive landscapes to inform product development and positioning. Knowledge of Product Strategy is used to prioritize features, allocate resources effectively, and align cross-functional teams towards a common objective, ensuring that the product delivers value to users and achieves organizational goals.

NAME: Travis Ci
DESCRIPTION: Travis CI is a continuous integration platform that is used to automate software testing and building processes. It allows developers to test their code changes in a consistent and automated way, which helps to ensure that code is always ready to be deployed. The platform integrates with popular code hosting platforms like GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab and allows developers to run their tests in different environments and operating systems to ensure compatibility. Travis CI also integrates with popular deployment tools, making it easier to automate the deployment process as well.

NAME: Genesys
DESCRIPTION: Genesys is a software platform that provides customer service solutions through various channels, such as voice, messaging, and social media. It enables businesses to offer personalized experiences to their customers, manage customer interactions, and gather data for analytics and insights. Genesys offers various features like routing, IVR, chatbots, workforce optimization, and analytics to improve customer engagement and agent productivity. It is widely used by contact centers and enterprises to offer efficient and effective customer service.

NAME: Trustworthiness
DESCRIPTION: Trustworthiness refers to an individual's ability to be reliable, dependable, and honest in all their professional interactions. It involves maintaining confidentiality, fulfilling commitments, demonstrating integrity, and showing consistency in actions and decisions. A trustworthy employee is one who can be relied upon to handle responsibilities and tasks with minimal supervision, and who upholds ethical standards, promoting a positive work environment. This skill is crucial in building and maintaining professional relationships, fostering teamwork, and enhancing organizational reputation.

NAME: Greeting Customers
DESCRIPTION: Greeting customers is an essential skill for anyone working in customer service or sales. It involves acknowledging customers when they enter a store or business, welcoming them, and offering assistance. A friendly greeting can set the tone for a positive customer experience and make them feel valued and respected. Effective greetings include eye contact, a smile, and a polite introduction. Mastering this skill is crucial for building strong customer relationships and increasing customer loyalty.

NAME: Beverage Products
DESCRIPTION: Beverage products refer to any type of drinkable product that can be consumed, including alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. A specialized skill in beverage products would involve expertise in the production, distribution, and marketing of beverages. This could include knowledge of brewing or distilling techniques, flavor profiles, and consumer preferences. It may also involve understanding packaging and labeling regulations, supply chain logistics, and sales strategies. A specialized skill in beverage products would be particularly valuable in the food and beverage industry, where competition is high and the demand for innovative, high-quality products is always increasing.

NAME: Delivery Pipelines
DESCRIPTION: Delivery Pipelines refer to a set of automated processes that facilitate the continuous integration and continuous delivery of software applications. This skill encompasses the design, implementation, and management of workflows that streamline the development, testing, and deployment phases of software projects. Knowledge of Delivery Pipelines is used to enhance collaboration among development teams, reduce the time to market, and ensure consistent quality through automated testing and deployment practices.

NAME: Grafana
DESCRIPTION: Grafana is an open-source visualization and analytics platform that helps users to visualize, analyze and understand data from different sources. It provides a user-friendly dashboard that displays real-time data in graphical format and allows users to create custom panels and dashboards to track and monitor different metrics. Grafana is often used in DevOps, IoT, and business intelligence applications, and requires specialized skills in data visualization, data analysis, and data manipulation.

NAME: Apache Spark
DESCRIPTION: Apache Spark is an open-source distributed computing software framework that is used for processing large datasets. It provides a high-level API for programming tasks in multiple languages and is designed to run on clusters of commodity hardware. Spark supports a wide range of data-processing tasks, including batch processing, real-time stream processing, machine learning, graph processing, and more. It is popular among data engineers, data scientists, and software developers as it enables fast and scalable data processing.

NAME: Peer Support
DESCRIPTION: Peer Support refers to the process of individuals providing assistance, encouragement, and understanding to one another based on shared experiences or challenges. This skill involves active listening, empathy, and the ability to share personal insights to foster a supportive environment. Peer Support is utilized in various settings, such as mental health, education, and community programs, to enhance resilience, promote well-being, and facilitate personal growth among participants.

NAME: Aluminum
DESCRIPTION: Aluminum refers to a lightweight, malleable metal known for its resistance to corrosion and excellent conductivity. This skill encompasses knowledge of aluminum properties, processing techniques, and applications in various industries, including construction, transportation, and packaging. Understanding Aluminum enables the user to select appropriate materials, design components, and implement manufacturing processes that leverage its unique characteristics for enhanced performance and efficiency.

NAME: Drafting Documents
DESCRIPTION: Drafting Documents is the ability to ensure that all terms, conditions, rights, and obligations of the parties involved are clearly and unambiguously expressed in the document. This skill involves the precise formulation of written content to create legally sound, comprehensive, and easily understandable documents. Professionals with expertise in Drafting Documents play a critical role in crafting contracts, agreements, and other legal or business documents to mitigate potential misunderstandings, disputes, and legal issues. The skill is applied through meticulous attention to detail, legal acumen, and language proficiency to articulate the content accurately and effectively.

NAME: Project Closure
DESCRIPTION: Project closure is the process of formally ending a project after its objectives have been achieved or it has been determined that the project is no longer feasible. It involves a set of activities that need to be performed to ensure that the project is completed on time, within budget, and meets its objectives. This process requires a specialized skill set that includes strong project management, communication, and leadership skills to ensure that stakeholders are satisfied and that the project has been successfully completed. The project manager plays a critical role in the project closure process, as they are responsible for ensuring the project is formally closed, documentation is complete, and lessons learned are captured and disseminated.

NAME: Petroleum Industry
DESCRIPTION: The Petroleum Industry is a complex and specialized field that involves the exploration, production, refining, transportation, and distribution of oil and natural gas products. Professionals within the industry must have extensive knowledge of geology, geophysics, engineering, chemistry, and economics to effectively operate and manage the production and distribution of these resources. The industry also requires strict adherence to safety and environmental regulations to ensure sustainable practices and minimize the potential for adverse impacts on communities and ecosystems.

NAME: Structural Work
DESCRIPTION: Structural Work refers to the construction and assembly of frameworks that support buildings and other structures. This skill involves understanding engineering principles, materials, and construction techniques to ensure stability and safety. Knowledge of Structural Work is applied in the design and execution of load-bearing elements, such as beams, columns, and foundations, to create resilient infrastructures that meet regulatory standards and withstand environmental forces.

NAME: Vendor Management
DESCRIPTION: Vendor Management is a strategic skill that involves the process of selecting suitable vendors, negotiating contracts, and reducing vendor-related risks. It also encompasses the ability to ensure service delivery according to agreed terms and maintaining a healthy vendor relationship. This skill is crucial in business operations as it aids in optimizing the value from vendors, ensuring quality and efficiency, and mitigating potential risks associated with vendor partnerships.

NAME: Customer Inquiries
DESCRIPTION: Customer Inquiries refer to the process of addressing questions and concerns raised by customers regarding products or services. Effective facilitation enhances learning, problem-solving, and decision-making within diverse teams.

NAME: Sensors
DESCRIPTION: Sensors are devices that detect or measure physical properties such as temperature, pressure, or light, and convert them into signals that can be processed and analyzed. Specializing in sensors involves knowledge and expertise in the design, development, and implementation of sensor systems for various applications such as environmental monitoring, medical devices, and industrial automation. This requires knowledge of sensor types, signal processing, and data analysis techniques. Specialized skills in sensors are highly sought after in fields such as robotics, automotive engineering, and aerospace.

NAME: Data Strategy
DESCRIPTION: Data Strategy refers to the comprehensive plan for managing, analyzing, and utilizing data to achieve organizational goals. This skill encompasses the identification of data needs, the establishment of data governance frameworks, and the implementation of data management practices. Knowledge of Data Strategy is used to align data initiatives with business objectives, enhance decision-making processes, and drive innovation through effective data utilization.

NAME: Furniture Cleaning
DESCRIPTION: Furniture Cleaning refers to the process of maintaining and restoring the appearance and hygiene of various types of furniture. This skill involves the use of appropriate cleaning techniques and products tailored to different materials, such as wood, fabric, and leather, to remove dirt, stains, and allergens. Knowledge of Furniture Cleaning is applied to enhance the longevity and aesthetic appeal of furniture while ensuring a healthy living environment by minimizing dust and contaminants.

NAME: Sales Prospecting
DESCRIPTION: Sales prospecting is the process of identifying potential customers or clients who are likely to buy a company's products or services. It involves researching, identifying, and contacting potential leads through various channels such as email, social media, or phone. This is a critical skill for sales professionals and requires a strategic approach, strong communication skills, and the ability to build relationships with potential customers. Effective prospecting can help a company generate new business, increase revenue, and expand its customer base.

NAME: Network Quality Of Service (QoS)
DESCRIPTION: Network Quality of Service (QoS) is a specialized set of skills related to ensuring the delivery of network traffic with predetermined levels of quality, reliability, and efficiency. QoS mechanisms can prioritize traffic, allocate bandwidth, limit or block unnecessary traffic, and prevent network congestion. QoS is particularly important for applications such as real-time video, voice, and gaming, where delay, jitter, and packet loss can severely impact the user experience. Skilled network engineers and administrators are needed to design and implement effective QoS policies and to troubleshoot issues related to QoS performance.

NAME: Financial Close
DESCRIPTION: Financial Close is the process of finalizing a company's financial statements for a specific accounting period. It includes reconciling balance sheet accounts, reviewing and adjusting revenue and expense accounts, and preparing financial reports. It is a critical process that requires specialized knowledge and expertise in accounting and financial analysis. A successful financial close ensures accurate and timely financial reporting, which is essential for making informed business decisions.

NAME: Pull/Merge Requests
DESCRIPTION: Pull/Merge Requests refer to a method used in version control systems to propose changes to a codebase. This skill involves creating a request for code modifications, which can be reviewed, discussed, and approved by team members before integration into the main project. Knowledge of Pull/Merge Requests is utilized to facilitate collaboration among developers, ensuring code quality and consistency while managing contributions from multiple sources. This process helps in tracking changes, resolving conflicts, and maintaining a clear project history.

NAME: Expectation Management
DESCRIPTION: Expectation management is a vital process that involves effectively communicating with stakeholders to set realistic expectations, ensuring that deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to a high standard. It requires strong communication skills, empathy, and the ability to negotiate and influence others. Proper expectation management leads to higher job satisfaction, better relationships, and successful project outcomes.

NAME: Courage
DESCRIPTION: Courage refers to the mental or moral strength to face fear, danger, or adversity. It involves making difficult decisions, taking risks, and standing up for one's principles, even in the face of opposition. This skill is used to overcome challenges, address conflicts, and pursue goals with determination and resilience.

NAME: Contract Compliance
DESCRIPTION: Contract Compliance refers to the adherence to the terms and conditions outlined in a contractual agreement. This skill involves monitoring and ensuring that all parties fulfill their obligations as specified in the contract, which may include performance standards, timelines, and payment terms. Knowledge of Contract Compliance is used to mitigate risks, resolve disputes, and maintain positive relationships between contracting parties by ensuring accountability and transparency throughout the contract lifecycle.

NAME: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
DESCRIPTION: GDPR is a regulation enforced by the European Union that aims to protect the privacy and personal data of individuals. It affects any business that processes or stores personal data of EU citizens. Compliance with GDPR involves ensuring that privacy policies are transparent and easy to understand, obtaining consent for data processing, implementing measures to protect data, and notifying authorities in the event of a data breach. It requires specialized knowledge of the regulation and its requirements to ensure compliance.

NAME: YouTube Marketing
DESCRIPTION: YouTube Marketing refers to the practice of promoting products, services, or brands through the YouTube platform, leveraging its vast audience and video content capabilities. This skill involves creating, optimizing, and distributing video content to engage viewers, increase brand awareness, and drive traffic to websites or other social media channels. Knowledge of YouTube Marketing is used to analyze audience behavior, implement effective SEO strategies, and utilize advertising options to enhance visibility and reach specific target demographics.

NAME: StorybookJS
DESCRIPTION: StorybookJS is an open source tool that allows developers to build and document UI components in isolation. It provides a user interface where designers and developers can create, manage, and test reusable components separately from the main application code, making it easier to identify and fix issues before they become part of the overall codebase. It is specialized skill for Front-end development.

NAME: Management Reporting
DESCRIPTION: Management Reporting refers to the process of collecting, analyzing, and presenting data to inform decision-making within an organization. This skill involves the creation of reports that summarize key performance indicators, financial metrics, and operational data to provide insights into business performance. Knowledge of Management Reporting is used to facilitate strategic planning, monitor progress against goals, and support resource allocation by delivering relevant information to stakeholders.

NAME: Expo (Application Development Framework)
DESCRIPTION: Expo is an open-source application development framework used for building cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, and web. It helps in speeding up the development process by providing easy-to-use libraries and tools such as UI components, APIs, and debugging tools. Expo also enables developers to test, deploy and share their applications with others using its cloud-based infrastructure. It does not require any configuration or installation of native development tools like Xcode or Android Studio, making it an ideal choice for developers who are starting with mobile app development.

NAME: Trade Marketing
DESCRIPTION: Trade Marketing refers to the strategies and tactics employed to promote products to retailers and distributors rather than directly to consumers. This skill involves understanding market dynamics, consumer behavior, and the retail environment to develop effective promotional campaigns and merchandising strategies. Knowledge of Trade Marketing is used to enhance product visibility, optimize shelf placement, and drive sales through collaboration with trade partners, ultimately contributing to brand growth and market share.

NAME: Sales Acumen
DESCRIPTION: Sales acumen is a common skill that refers to the ability to understand and effectively navigate the buying and selling process. It includes a range of abilities such as the ability to identify customer needs, develop rapport, negotiate effectively, and close deals. Developing sales acumen takes time and practice, but can be an important skill for professionals across a broad range of industries.

NAME: Operational Performance Management
DESCRIPTION: Operational Performance Management is the process of managing the day-to-day operations of a business to achieve desired outcomes. It involves measuring and analyzing performance metrics to identify areas of improvement, creating and implementing strategies to optimize performance, and monitoring progress to ensure success. A specialized skill in operational performance management requires expertise in data analysis, process optimization, project management, communication, and leadership. Effective operational performance management can improve efficiency, reduce costs, increase customer satisfaction, and ultimately lead to organizational success.

NAME: Technology Scouting
DESCRIPTION: Technology Scouting is the process of seeking out and evaluating new technologies and innovations that can be used to address business challenges or opportunities. It requires specialized skills such as a deep understanding of the industry, knowledge of emerging technologies and trends, and the ability to identify potential opportunities and risks. The goal of technology scouting is to help organizations stay competitive and innovative by identifying and adopting new technologies that can improve their operations or create new revenue streams.

NAME: Technical Design
DESCRIPTION: Technical Design refers to the process of creating detailed specifications and plans for the development of systems, products, or structures. This skill encompasses the analysis of requirements, the application of engineering principles, and the creation of design documentation that guides the implementation phase. Knowledge of Technical Design is used to ensure that projects meet functional, aesthetic, and regulatory standards while optimizing performance and efficiency throughout the development lifecycle.

NAME: Kaizen Methodology
DESCRIPTION: Kaizen methodology is a continuous improvement approach that focuses on small, incremental changes to improve processes, products, and services. It involves the active participation of all stakeholders across an organization and aims for sustained improvement by eliminating waste, reducing costs, and increasing efficiency. It requires a specialized skillset, including data analysis, problem-solving, and leadership, to successfully implement and sustain the approach.

NAME: Knowledge Transfer
DESCRIPTION: A short summary of knowledge transfer as a common skill is that it involves sharing ideas, information, and expertise with others in a way that allows them to acquire and apply the same knowledge. It is important for employees to be able to transfer knowledge to their colleagues, as it helps to strengthen the team and improves overall productivity. An effective knowledge transfer requires clear communication, patience, and the ability to adapt to different learning styles. It can be achieved through various methods, including training sessions, mentorship, and documentation.

NAME: UI/UX Strategy

DESCRIPTION: UI/UX strategy refers to the process of creating a plan for designing user interfaces and user experiences that are effective, engaging, and intuitive for users. It involves defining user goals, identifying user needs and behaviors, conducting user research, creating prototypes, and iterating on design ideas. This specialized skill requires expertise in human psychology, graphic design, information architecture, and other related fields. The ultimate goal of a UI/UX strategy is to create digital products that provide unique and positive experiences for users, while also meeting the business goals of the organization.

NAME: Generative Adversarial Networks
DESCRIPTION: Generative Adversarial Networks refer to a class of machine learning frameworks that consist of two neural networks, a generator and a discriminator, which compete against each other to improve their performance. This skill involves understanding the principles of adversarial training, where the generator creates synthetic data while the discriminator evaluates its authenticity. Knowledge of Generative Adversarial Networks is used in various applications, including image generation, video synthesis, and data augmentation, by enabling the creation of realistic data samples that can enhance model training and improve overall performance.

NAME: PTC Creo (CAD Suite)
DESCRIPTION: PTC Creo is a CAD software suite used for 3D modeling, design, simulation, and analysis. It allows users to create, modify, and analyze designs for a variety of industries, including manufacturing, engineering, and architecture. PTC Creo offers a range of tools for creating complex designs, including the ability to work with surfaces and parametric modeling features. It also includes simulation and analysis capabilities for testing design performance and functionality. PTC Creo is regularly updated with new features and improvements to ensure a high level of accuracy and efficiency in design work.

NAME: Component Libraries

DESCRIPTION: Component Libraries is the process of creating, maintaining and sharing reusable UI components across web or mobile platforms.
